title: The API skips the passkey lock, so anyone with Jordan's tailnet login on any device can use it
trigger: a device signed in to Jordan's tailnet is lost or compromised
body: Jordan accepted this in D-4 (Tailscale login is the gate, no separate key). What limits it: a Mac only answers Claude while its Allow Claude switch is on (D-6), and switching it off or pausing cuts Claude off at once (S-17). Remove a lost device from the tailnet at login.tailscale.com (SECURITY.md).
